title: Design System: GlucoRead
scope: The whole product: landing page, auth screens and the authenticated app. warm.css loads for every page from main/templates/main/_theme_head.html, after theme.css (extended to the app 2026-11-24).

display.purpose: Hero headline only; the cover label headline is a near sibling.

title.purpose: Column guide rows, notices, form titles, auth card heading.

label.purpose: Printed field labels and table column heads.

figure.purpose: Printed totals and every value the unit switch rewrites; tabular lining numerals.

hand.purpose: Only what the diary's owner wrote: entries, filled-in form lines, margin notes.

shadows.name: sheet-on-cloth
shadows.purpose: Spreads, cover label, auth card; stamp button hover.

shadows.name: tucked-slip
shadows.purpose: The app slip tucked into a page.

shadows.name: gutter
shadows.value: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(70,50,20,0.07) 38%, rgba(70,50,20,0.2) 50%, rgba(70,50,20,0.07) 62%, transparent)
shadows.dark: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.18) 38%, rgba(0,0,0,0.45) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.18) 62%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: 72px fold between facing pages, on the left page only.

shadows.name: stamp-frame
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 3px <fill>, inset 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 45%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: The stamp button's inner inked frame (55% on hover).

shadows.name: double-printed-rule
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 10px var(--paper), inset 0 0 0 11px var(--ink-3), inset 0 0 0 14px var(--paper), inset 0 0 0 15px var(--ink-3)

motion.name: ink-draw-section
motion.purpose: Strokes below the fold draw once when their section is revealed (IntersectionObserver, threshold 0.3); list items stagger 0.15s.

motion.name: ink-draw-hero
motion.purpose: Above-the-fold strokes draw once on load.

motion.name: tick-draw
motion.purpose: Pressing a tick option draws its tick.

motion.name: stage-layer
motion.purpose: Graph-page step layers; autoplays once (1.5s, 3.2s), never loops.

motion.name: unit-rewrite
motion.purpose: Values rewritten by the unit switch.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no animation; strokes present, stage on its fullest step

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Paper Logbook"**

GlucoRead's public face is the paper glucose diary every insulin user was handed at diagnosis, laid open on its own sage book-cloth cover, finally doing the adding-up. The ground is cloth; everything a visitor reads sits on a page of diary paper resting on it. Pages carry the booklet's printed furniture: faint blue rules, a double rose margin line, a darkening gutter between facing pages, folio numbers at the foot. Entries are written into that paper in biro; what GlucoRead works out (totals, averages, time in range) is printed beneath them. The contrast between the hand and the print is the product's argument, made visually.

The palette is three inks plus paper. Biro navy writes glucose, plum pencil writes insulin, ochre pencil writes meals, leaf green marks in range, sage cloth binds the book and carries every action, and red is the one alarm. Density is that of a well-kept booklet: generous page margins, tight ruled rows inside them. Depth is physical and shallow, paper lying on cloth, never floating UI. Motion is a pen: ink strokes draw themselves on once, and the rest of the page holds still.

**Scope.** This world governs the whole product: the landing page (`landing/`), the auth screens (sign in, register, password reset, via `users/templates/users/auth_base.html`) and the authenticated app (`main/templates/main/base.html` and everything extending it). The user extended it to the app on 2026-11-24, reversing the 2026-11-23 "landing and auth only" decision. The world is delivered by `main/static/main/css/warm.css`, which redefines theme.css's raw `-l` / `-d` tokens and is loaded once, for every page, by `main/templates/main/_theme_head.html`, straight after theme.css. Never link it from an individual template, and never load theme.css without it. theme.css still carries the token names, the primitives and the original teal values underneath; warm.css overrides those values.
keyCharacteristics: Sage book-cloth ground; every readable block is a sheet of paper on it.
Handwriting (Kalam, biro) for what a person logs; print for everything GlucoRead computes or says.
Colour is data: each log type has its own ink, and red means above range.
Printed booklet furniture: rules, double margin line, gutter, folios, double-ruled totals line.
One motion: hand-drawn strokes draw on once.
Light is the diary on a desk by day; dark is the same diary under a lamp at night.

rules.name: The One Alarm Rule
rules.body: Alarm Red means a reading is above range. On the public surfaces its only other use is a form error. Nothing decorative is red, and a high is never colour alone: it is also circled, bolded, enlarged or labelled "above range" for screen readers.

rules.name: The Margin Is Ruling Rule
rules.body: Margin Rose is printed ruling, a 1px double line set inside the page. It never colours text, values, fills or states, and it is deliberately lighter and pinker than Alarm Red so the two never read as one.

rules.name: The Column Ink Rule
rules.body: Each log type writes in its own ink everywhere it appears: glucose biro, insulin plum, meals ochre, in range leaf. A new figure inherits these through the `.t-*` tones; it never picks a fresh hue for a log type.

rules.name: The Hand Logs, Print Computes Rule
rules.body: Kalam is only ever something the diary's owner wrote: a reading, a dose, a meal, a date, their own margin note. Totals, averages, labels, headings, copy and controls are printed. If the visitor has to read it to act, it is print.

rules.name: The Lining Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number that is computed or can be rewritten by the unit switch uses `tabular-nums lining-nums`, so a value never shifts sideways when it changes.

rules.name: The Paper On Cloth Rule
rules.body: If it is not a sheet of paper (a spread, the cover label, the auth card, a tucked slip), it does not cast a shadow. Inside a page, structure comes from rules, the double totals rule and hairlines.

rules.name: The One Ink Motion Rule
rules.body: Ink draws on once, and only ink moves of its own accord. Hero strokes draw on load (1s, 0.5s delay; the ring at 1.1s). Every other stroke waits until its section arrives, then draws in 0.9s on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, staggered 0.15s in lists. Nothing loops and nothing reacts to scroll position. State changes a person causes (a tick, a step layer fading in over 0.5s, the unit rewrite, hover) may transition briefly; nothing else animates. Strokes are drawn by default and only wait when the script has marked the root `ink-ready`; under reduced motion every stroke is simply present.

dos: **Do** deliver this world to every page through `_theme_head.html`, which loads warm.css after theme.css, so it re-binds the raw `-l` / `-d` tokens everywhere at once.
**Do** put every readable block on a sheet of Diary Paper; the cloth carries only the topbar, the closer and the footer, in Cover Cream.
**Do** write logged values in Kalam in their column ink (glucose biro, insulin plum, meals ochre) and print every computed value in Atkinson 700 with tabular lining figures.
**Do** mark a high with Alarm Red plus a second signal: the ink ring, bold weight, a larger point, or "above range" text for screen readers.
**Do** draw new hand marks as single SVG paths with `pathLength="1"` and draw them on with `stroke-dashoffset`, once.
**Do** use the same example day for every figure (avg 7.8, 35.0 U, 165 g / 13.8 BU, 80% in range).
**Do** stack spreads below 960px with a dashed fold line, and let wide figures scroll in their own box rather than shrink their labels.
donts: **Don't** link warm.css from individual templates or hard-code a hex in app CSS; and don't handwrite entries in the app, where they have to scan.
**Don't** use Alarm Red or Margin Rose for decoration, emphasis, links or brand moments.
**Don't** set copy, headings, labels, controls or totals in the hand.
**Don't** give shadows or cards to anything inside a page; separate with rules and hairlines.
**Don't** add entrance, scroll-linked, looping or parallax motion; only ink draws on.
**Don't** put a small label or eyebrow above a heading; a column's name is a printed header over its own fields.
